title: Memcode AI
excerpt: Memcode is an agentic coding CLI that builds a persistent model of your codebase for better context and memory. Install in one line.
content_html:
Memcode · agentic coding with memory

Your repo has a history.
Your agent should know it.

Memcode remembers your codebase the way a senior engineer does, then puts a coding agent on top of that memory, right in your terminal. Install in one line.

Why Memcode

Not another chat wrapper. A persistent memory system that makes the agent actually useful, because it knows what came before.

Memcode builds a living picture of your codebase: how it fits together, what was decided, and why. Every session starts already oriented instead of re-reading everything.

Other agents burn the first ten minutes rediscovering your codebase and still miss the why. Memcode picks up exactly where it left off, without spending your tokens to re-learn.

A fast TUI in a single static binary. No Electron, no browser tab, no IDE plugin. It starts instantly and stays out of your way.

Context and decisions persist across sessions. The agent gets sharper the longer it works in your repo, because it remembers what it learned last time.

The first session is the last cold start.
Every session after starts ahead.

Every other agent starts from scratch each session, re-reading files and re-asking questions you already answered. Memcode remembers, and it compounds.

01

Work like you always do

Commit, edit, ship. No annotations and no special workflow. Memcode watches your repo and keeps up on its own.

02

It remembers what matters

Not just the code, but the decisions, the dead ends, and the reasons. The context you would otherwise re-explain every session.

03

Every session starts ahead

Open the terminal and the agent already knows where things stand. No warm-up, no re-reading, no "let me look around first."

Chat, wired to your knowledge

Every frontier model in one place, with your DataHub docs on tap. Ask a question, get an answer grounded in your team's documents, and share the thread.

Agents that work while you don't

Describe the job in plain language and get a custom agent: research, reports, monitoring, follow-ups. Run it on demand, on a schedule, or from a webhook, with web search, email, and your connected tools.

Give chat your team's knowledge

Architecture decisions, runbooks, API references, design docs. Upload them to DataHub and chat on the web can search them and cite them in its answers.

content_html_zh:
Memcode · 使用内存进行代理编码

你的仓库有历史。你的代理应该知道它。

Memcode 以高级工程师的方式记住您的代码库，然后将编码代理放在该内存之上，就在您的终端中。 安装在一条线上。

为什么选择Memcode

不是另一个聊天包装。 持久内存系统使代理真正有用，因为它知道之前发生了什么。

Memcode 构建了代码库的生动图景：它如何组合在一起、决定了什么以及为什么。 每个课程一开始就已经有针对性，而不是重新阅读所有内容。

其他代理花了前十分钟重新发现你的代码库，但仍然不知道原因。 Memcode 会准确地从上次中断的地方继续，无需花费您的代币来重新学习。

单个静态二进制文件中的快速 TUI。 没有 Electron，没有浏览器选项卡，没有 IDE 插件。 它会立即启动并不会妨碍您。

背景和决策在整个会话中持续存在。 代理在您的存储库中工作的时间越长，就会变得越敏锐，因为它会记住上次学到的内容。

第一个会话是最后一次冷启动。之后的每个会话都提前开始。

每个其他代理每次会话都从头开始，重新阅读文件并重新询问您已经回答的问题。 Memcode 会记住，并且会复合。

01

像往常一样工作

提交、编辑、发布。 没有注释，也没有特殊的工作流程。 Memcode 会监视您的存储库并自行跟进。

02

它会记住重要的事情

不仅仅是代码，还有决策、死胡同和原因。 否则您将重新解释每个会话的上下文。

03

每节课都提前开始

打开终端，代理就已经知道情况了。 没有热身，没有重读，没有“让我先环顾四周”。

聊天，连接您的知识

每个前沿模型都集中在一个地方，您的 DataHub 文档随时可用。 提出问题，根据团队文档获得答案，然后分享主题。

当您不工作时，代理可以工作

用通俗易懂的语言描述工作并获得定制代理：研究、报告、监控、跟进。 使用网络搜索、电子邮件和连接的工具按需、按计划或从网络钩子运行它。

分享您团队的知识

架构决策、运行手册、API 参考、设计文档。 将它们上传到 DataHub 并在网络上聊天可以搜索它们并在答案中引用它们。
